title: arachniodes quadripinnata subsp. fimbriata
intro: Arachniodes quadripinnata subsp. fimbriata, commonly known as Fimbriated Lady Fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the genus Arachniodes, native to East Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of Arachniodes quadripinnata subsp. fimbriata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its use in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
